claims.text: Leads reached within 90 days of going cold re-engage more often than leads left dormant for a year or more
SMS reactivation outperforms email-only outreach by a wide margin in home-services benchmarks
Multichannel campaigns combining SMS, email, and voice outperform single-channel outreach by roughly 2-3X in reported benchmarks
Segmented, history-specific messaging outperforms generic blasts
The platform runs automated win-back sequences for dormant contacts, sorted by how long they've been quiet
